players.name: Cal Raleigh
players.summary: Snapped 0-for-38 hitless streak with singles in the 7th and 9th innings; scored three runs in Mariners' 10-2 win at Houston.

players.name: Bryce Harper
players.summary: Back-to-back HR with Schwarber in the 1st — Harper's 11th of the year; Phillies won 2-1 at Fenway behind Wheeler's gem.

players.name: Luis Arraez
players.summary: 0-for-3 with an intentional walk; Giants won 6-2 at Dodger Stadium for 2nd straight win in the series.

players.name: Bo Bichette
players.summary: Scored a run in the 3rd as Mets routed Detroit 10-2; leads team with 37 hits this season.

players.name: Lindor/McGonigle
players.summary: Drew a walk and swiped his 6th steal of the season; excellent defense in Tigers' 10-2 loss at Citi Field.

players.name: Pete Crow-Armstrong
players.summary: 0-for-4 but robbed a hit with a leaping wall catch in CF; Cubs fell to NL-best Braves (29-13).

players.name: Jackson Merrill
players.summary: Singled in the 3rd inning; Padres lost 6-4 as Milwaukee extended winning streak to five.

players.name: Teoscar Hernandez
players.summary: On 15-day IL with left groin strain since May 6; expected return ~May 21.

players.name: Stanton/Rice
players.summary: HR in Yankees' 11-3 blowout of Orioles; Rice and Judge forming a historic HR duo in franchise history.

players.name: Devin Williams
players.summary: W+SV after Mets bullpen mistranslation; extended scoreless streak to 7 straight, now 2W/6SV on the season.

players.name: Zack Wheeler
players.summary: Masterful 7.1 IP at Fenway: 6H/1ER/0BB/4K on 87 pitches; 2nd win, ERA drops to 2.55.

players.name: Cole Ragans
players.summary: On 15-day IL (retroactive May 7) — left elbow impingement; no structural damage, no return timetable.

players.name: Chase Burns
players.summary: Not his rotation turn; last started May 10 (6 IP, 1 ER). ERA 2.21 on the season.

players.name: Nathan Eovaldi
players.summary: Scratched from start vs. ARI with left side tightness; Rangers testing for oblique strain — potential IL stint.

players.name: Emmet Sheehan
players.summary: Not scheduled Tuesday; next start Thu May 14 vs. Giants at Dodger Stadium.

players.name: Reid Detmers
players.summary: Not his rotation turn; Detmers (ERA 4.28) scheduled for Wed May 13 vs. Guardians.

injuries.name: Teoscar Hernandez
injuries.note: Left groin strain; placed on IL May 6. Expected return ~May 21.

injuries.name: Cole Ragans
injuries.note: Left elbow impingement (valgus extension overload); IL retroactive to May 7. No structural damage on X-ray.

injuries.name: Nathan Eovaldi
injuries.note: Left side tightness; scratched from May 12 start vs. ARI. Rangers testing for oblique strain — potential IL stint.
